  Lola Osborne, Acting Director of Parks, Recreation and Community
  Services, provided introductory comments, and Enrique Arroyo,

  Councilmember Jones stated his intention to support the naming of
  the pool at Robinson Park Recreation Center in honor of John J.
  Kennedy; and asked the City Manager to reach out to the Rose Bowl
  Aquatics Center (RBAC) staff to begin discussions on possibly

  The City Council spoke on the significant efforts of former
  Councilmember Kennedy to secure funding for a pool at Robinson
  Park that will serve minority youth in Pasadena, and support access to
  water safety and swimming, with various members speaking in support
  of naming the pool in his honor, and working with RBAC staff in
  honoring Dr. Edna L. Griffin.

  Taleen Hindoyan, representing Pasadena Sister Cities

  Liberty McCoy, Pasadena resident
